en: A printed postcard with a central black‑and‑white illustration framed like a stamp. The image shows a large, aggressive male face with exaggerated features behind a sleeping infant, with flames on both sides and the word "Ruhr!" at the bottom. Above are denominations "50 Mark + 1 CcO" and the year "1923". Below the illustration on the card are German captions crediting the etching to Ludwig Hesshaimer, titled "Die schwarze Schmach", described as a design for a Ruhr relief stamp, along with the publisher information and the number 53.
